) 
 

register a view with both the session and the model and set callbacks.

Returns:
the new view object, or NULL
Parameters:

name the name-tag for the view
data user-data (usually administrative struct, browser_view *, icon_view *, ...)
evt_view what to call when the contents of the model change (new file, ...)
dst_data when this entry is destroyed, call this function to release user-data
set_selection what to call to set ns->selection on the view

noir_sess* noir_sess_copy (  noir_sess *  d,
noir_sess *  s
) 
 

copy session struct 's' to struct 'd', a proto-struct obtained with noir_sess_new().

'd' will retain the serial issued by noir_sess_new() rather than duplicate that of 's'.

Returns:
the new session
Parameters:
d buffer for the destination-session
s the source-session

int noir_sess_drop (  noir_sess *  ns  ) 
 

drop the session associated with a window.

hook this into the "window-destroyed" callback of your toolkit.

lock the session-chain's lock, find the session, remove it from the chain, then call noir_sess_free() on it. unlock.

called from evidence::closed().

Returns:
an error-code
Parameters:
ns the session to drop

static void noir_sess_free (  noir_sess *  ns  )  [static]
 

free memory associated with a session.

session is expected to already have been removed from session-list. if the session still has views ("clients"), these will be removed. called from noir_sess_drop().

Parameters:
ns the session to remove
